chapter.verse: Lam khat panin, Thukham in a nung cianga hong piang ding thuhoihte’ lim taktak hi loin, a liim bek hong lak ahih ciangin kum simin a kipia biaknate tawh a nai mite a kicingsak zo kei hi.
Ahih kei leh, a bia mite in khatvei bekin a sian’ tho khit uh ciang lungsim kisuan’na om nawnlo ding ahih manin biak piakna piak kikkik ding kisam nawnlo ding hilo ahi hiam?
Tu-in ahih leh, hih biakna pia-in, mawhnate kum simin kingaihsunin a om hi.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, bawngtal’ si leh keel’ si in mawhna paaikhia zo lo uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Khazih in leitungah hong pai ciangin: “Pasian aw, gangawh biakna leh piakna na deih kei hi, keimah ading pumpi khat na bawlkhol zo hi.
Mawhna maisak nading pumpi mei tawh kihal biakna leh, piaknate hangin na lungkim kei hi.
Tua lai takin keimah in, Lai Siangtho sungah keimah ngaihsunin a kigelh mah bangin, ‘Na deihna bangin sem dingin hong pai ka hi hi, Pasian aw,’ a ci hi.
Thukham bang bawlnate pan Khazih in, “Biaknate, piaknate, pumpi mei tawh kihal biaknate, mawh maisakna biaknate, nang in na deih kei, na lungkim kei hi,” ci-in a masa-in a cih khit ciangin,
khatvei, “Na deihna bang sem dingin ka hong pai hi,” a cihna in a nihna a kipsak nadingin a masa pen a paaikhia hi.
Tua deihna tawh, Zeisu Khazih’ pumpi khatvei piakna hangin eite in siangthona i ngah hi.
Siampi peuhmah in ni simin na semin, cikmah hunin mawhna a maisak zo lo piaknate pia kikkikin a ding uh hi.
Tua Topa ahih leh, mawhna maisak nadingin biakna khat bek a piak khit-a kipan, Pasian’ ziat lamah a tawntungin tu-in,
a galte khempeuh a khe ngakna nuai-ah a khiat dong matengin ngakin a om hi.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, siangthona a ngah mite, khatvei biakna tawh kicin’ tawntungna a ngahsak hi.
Kha Siangtho in zong eite kiangah teci hong pan’na in:

“Tua hun khit ciangin amau tawh ka kiciamna un, kei Topa in, “Ka thukhamte amaute lungtang sung uhah ka guan’sak ding hi, Amau lungsim tung uhah ka gelh ding hi,” ci-in tu ma-in thu a piak khit ciangin khatvei:
“Amaute mawhnate khialhnate, Lungngai nawn loin ka om ding hi,” a ci hi.
Tuate kimaisak leh a nung ciangin mawhna hanga biakna bawl nading thu om nawn lo hi.
Tua ahih ciangin ute naute aw, Zeisu’ pumpi ahi dalna puan tawh, tua Topa in eite ading a hon’ nuntakna lampi thakah eite in Mun Siangtho Bel sungah Zeisu’ sisan suangin i tum nading launa om lo a,
Pasian’ innpi a uk siampi ukpa om ahih ciangin
eite in lungsim kisuan’na om loh nadingin kitheh a, tui siangtho tawh i pumpi i kisil khit ciangin up khialhna om lo, upna kipin dikna tawh a dim lungsim nei-in Pasian kiangah nai ni.
Lametna thu tawh kipawl i man’nate sawisak loin lenkip ni. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, thuciamna a koihpa in thuman mi ahi hi.
Tua tham loin, itna lungsim neih nading ahi zongin, a pha-a gamtat nadingin kihansuah nading ahi zongin, khat leh khat kidomto ni.
Mi kimkhatte’ ngeina bangin khat leh khat kikhopna thu pelh loin, khat leh khat kihansuah ni. A Ni hong nai zo ahih thu na thei uh ahih ciangin na hahkat zaw un.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, thuman i theih khit ciangin i deihna zui-in i mawh kik leh, a nung ciangin mawh maisak nading biakna a om kei ding hi;
daantatna thuak ding cih kihtakhuai a piang ding thu leh thu nial mite a siasak ding hehna meikuang bek a om lai hi.
Moses’ Thukham a nial mi in teci nih bang, thum bang a om leh, hehpihna ngah loin a si hi.

Tua bang tham loin, Pasian’ Tapa, a khe tawh sik a, amah a siangthosak thuciamna si a siangtho lo ci-in ngaihsun a, thupha a pia Kha Siangtho a simmawh mi in bang zah a lianzaw daantatna a thuak ding na um uh hiam?
“Phulakna in keima thu ahi hi, A mawhna tawh kituakin ka thukkik ding hi,” cih leh, “Pasian in ama mite thu a khen ding hi,” cih thu a piapa i thei hi.
A nungta Pasian khut sungah puk nading thu in a lauhuai taktak thu ahi hi.

Note khuavak sungah na tun’ khit uh ciangin mite mai-ah kisiatna, bawlsiatna thuakin, tua bang a thuakte tawh kipawl khat na hi uh ahi zongin, gimna lian mahmahte dona, nidang lai-a na thuak uh na ngaihsun un.
Tua lai-in note in khihna a thuak mite na khasiat uh tham loin, neihsa a phazaw a kip tawntung sum a om hi ci-in thei-in na sum na paite uh hong kisuh ciangin na lungdam uh a, na mang uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin phattuamna lian mahmah tawh kizom na lau lohna lungsim uh na paaikhia kei un.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, Pasian’ deihna bang na nasep khit uh ciangin ama kamciamna na ngah nadingun thuakzawhna lungsim na kisam uh hi.
“Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, A hong pai dingpa in khawl loin, Tawlno khat khit ciangin a hong tung ding hi.
Ka midik in upna tawh a nungta ding hi, a nung kin leh, ka lungsim in Tua mi hangin lungdamna a nei kei hi,” ci-in Pasian in thu a pia hi.
Eite i hih leh, kisiatna tung dingin a nungkin mite lakah i om kei hi; gupkhiatna a ngah upna a nei mite lakah i om hi.
